name: Yuma
source:
She is the devilish little girl and the younger twin sister who loves to toy with her brother. She is very bad with money.
 
Compared to Yumi, who's impression is of being very energetic, she is a bit more mature, but can be very insidious when need be. Yuma is the one who reinforces her sister Yumi's mischief. Unlike Yumi, Yuma gets good grades. 

Favorite things: Money, Bananas, stuffed toys

Dislikes: Insects

Best Dish: Onigiri

[From [url=http://pacopacosoft.jp/dl/pk010/]official site[/url]]
